text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан runs with a mad fervor in
the exalted
event that is the Arima
Kinen, and her results
reflect her
fantastic performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now cognizant of Ryan's abilities, Oguri
Cap
vows to face her again in the same
race next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this experience in hand, Mejiro
Ryan aims
for a rematch against Mejiro
McQueen with the
spring Tenno Sho
next in her sights!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
